title: ContextLift: Breaking the Spurious Correlation Behind Conditional Emergent Misalignment
abstract: arXiv:2610.21633v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Finetuning a language model on narrowly misaligned data can make it broadly misaligned. Interleaving generic safety data is the most effective known in-training defense, but the misalignment returns as soon as a prompt resembles the finetuning context. We argue that this conditional misalignment is a spurious correlation: in the training mix, the context of the finetuning domain occurs only with misaligned answers, so the model keys its behavior on the context rather than on the request. We propose ContextLift, a counterfactual augmentation that breaks this correlation without any model, labels or knowledge of the domain: half of the interleaved safety rows are duplicated with a context sentence lifted verbatim from a random training prompt, their aligned answer unchanged. On Qwen2.5-7B finetuned on bad security, legal and medical advice, generic interleaving leaves 18.9%, 41.9% and 58.2% misaligned answers under a domain cue; ContextLif

translated_title: ContextLift：打破条件性涌现失调背后的伪相关
translated_abstract: 在狭窄失调数据上微调语言模型可能使其变得广泛失调。交错插入通用安全数据是目前已知最有效的训练中防御方法，但一旦提示词类似于微调时的上下文，失调行为就会重新出现。我们认为这种条件性失调是一种伪相关：在训练混合数据中，微调领域的上下文只与失调答案同时出现，因此模型将其行为与上下文而非请求本身关联起来。我们提出ContextLift，一种反事实数据增强方法，可在不需要任何模型、标签或领域知识的情况下打破这种相关性：一半的交错安全数据行被复制，并从随机训练提示中逐字提取一句上下文句子加入其中，其对齐的答案保持不变。在基于不良安全、法律和医疗建议微调的Qwen2.5-7B模型上，通用交错方法在领域提示下仍留下18.9%、41.9%和58.2%的失调答案；而ContextLift（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出ContextLift反事实数据增强方法，通过将随机训练提示中的上下文句子复制到安全数据中来打破条件性失调背后的伪相关，无需任何模型、标签或领域知识即可消除领域提示触发的失调行为。
en_tdlr: ContextLift is a counterfactual augmentation that breaks the spurious correlation behind conditional emergent misalignment by duplicating safety rows with context sentences lifted verbatim from random training prompts, eliminating domain-cued misalignment without requiring any model, labels, or domain knowledge.
